panels.title: Unrealized P&L
panels.description: IB's unrealized P&L for the account, as TWS shows it. The Positions table's per-position figures are the bot's own (from its quotes).

panels.title: P&L today
panels.description: IB's daily P&L for the account, as TWS shows it: open positions plus positions closed today and commissions. The Daily P&L by symbol table covers open positions only, so its total can differ.

panels.title: Realized P&L
panels.description: IB's realized P&L for the account (TWS's Realized P&L): from positions closed, net of commissions.

panels.title: SPX move today
panels.description: SPX since the last close

panels.title: SPX delta
panels.description: Beta-weighted; one axis, SPX units. Green: SPX delta neutral (|beta delta $| within the band: a 1% SPX day costs at most delta_band_theta_days of theta, capped at delta_band_nav_pct of net liq). Orange: up to twice the band. Red: beyond.

targets.expr:
label_replace((sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)) * 0 - 1e15, "step", "base", "", "")
 or label_replace(-2 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "lo2", "", "")
 or label_replace(-1 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "lo1", "", "")
 or label_replace(1 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "hi1", "", "")
 or label_replace(2 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "hi2", "", "")

panels.title: Beta delta $
panels.description: Portfolio delta $ x beta: SPX delta x SPX price. +1% SPX ≈ 1% of this. Green: SPX delta neutral (|beta delta $| within the band: a 1% SPX day costs at most delta_band_theta_days of theta, capped at delta_band_nav_pct of net liq). Orange: up to twice the band. Red: beyond.

targets.expr:
label_replace(sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) * 0 - 1e15, "step", "base", "", "")
 or label_replace(-2 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "lo2", "", "")
 or label_replace(-1 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "lo1", "", "")
 or label_replace(1 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "hi1", "", "")
 or label_replace(2 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "hi2", "", "")

panels.title: Theta / day
panels.description: $ per day from time decay

panels.title: Vega / vol pt
panels.description: $ per 1 point of implied vol

panels.title: Volga / vol pt
panels.description: How much the portfolio's vega ($ per vol point) changes when implied vol rises one point

panels.title: Gamma P&L / day
panels.description: Realized: gamma's share of today's P&L so far (the attribution table's Gamma column). Expected: what an average day earns (+) or costs (-) from gamma alone, 1/2 x gamma x (move x SPX)^2, with the move from VIX (VIX / sqrt(252), about 1% at VIX 16): the expected P&L of staying delta neutral (negative when short gamma). Net carry: Theta / day + Expected: positive means being delta neutral pays you. Break-even (max): short gamma, the biggest daily SPX move a day's theta pays for; bigger days lose. Break-even (min): long gamma, the smallest move that earns back a day's theta; smaller days lose.

panels.title: Account
panels.description: IB account values (old Account summary). Cushion = excess liquidity / net liquidation.

panels.title: Cushion
panels.description: Excess liquidity / net liquidation. IB liquidates at 0.

panels.title: Margin used
panels.description: Margin in use as a share of net liquidation

panels.title: Attention
panels.description: Strategies with an open P0 (hard) or P1 (time / profit) review signal from the Portfolio Manager, including P0 'data unreliable'. Click for the review queue.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the monitor last refreshed

panels.title: SPX
panels.description: SPX index level now: the 0 point of the SPX P&L curve.

panels.title: VIX
panels.description: VIX now, the market's 30-day at-the-money implied vol of SPX: the 0 point of the VIX P&L curve. Green below 15, yellow 15-20, orange 20-30, red 30 and up (the VIX hedge closes above 30).

panels.title: Theoretical P&L by SPX price: now and after the resize
panels.description: The portfolio's P&L if SPX were at each price (-10% to +10%), now and after the trade plan's resizes. Options repriced at current IV, each stock moving beta x the SPX move. Both lines cross 0 at today's SPX.

panels.title: Theoretical P&L by VIX level: now and after the resize
panels.description: The portfolio's P&L if VIX were at each level (-10 to +20 points, not below 9) with SPX unchanged, now and after the resizes. Every option's IV moves by the VIX change; VIX options' underlying moves with VIX. Single stocks' IV usually moves less than VIX, so this overstates their vega P&L.

panels.title: Portfolio greeks: now and after the resize
panels.description: SPX beta-weighted, now and after the trade plan below (the resizes of what you hold).

panels.title: Stress P&L by SPX move
panels.description: Options repriced at current IV. Beta-weighted: each stock moves beta x the SPX move; All betas = 1: every stock moves with SPX.

panels.title: VIX hedge
panels.description: Long VIX calls held (beyond ignore_dte); the allocation for new buys at today's VIXMO (your [strategy.vix_call_hedge.allocation] bands, a share of net liq; 'no VIXMO' until VIXMO quotes); and the VIX level that sells them.

panels.title: Hedge
panels.description: What the VIX call hedge would do now.

panels.title: Trade plan: resize held positions
panels.description: Brings SPX delta toward 0 by resizing each symbol's position toward its target (shares, one option, or a whole vertical). Status: active when approve_trades = "auto" (the trading strategy places it while off neutral), preview when "manual". Never adds short options (held back as 'by hand'), skips symbols with open orders and index options. From the monitor (every minute). Open new positions with ./pretrade.sh.

targets.expr: sum by (trade, contracts, note, status) (thetagang_target_plan_units) or label_replace(label_replace(sum(thetagang_target_plan_cost) * NaN, "trade", "Σ total", "", ""), "contracts", "Σ Total", "", "")

panels.title: Beta delta $ by symbol
panels.description: What each symbol contributes to SPX delta

panels.title: Share of SPX exposure
panels.description: |Beta delta $| per symbol: where the market risk sits

panels.title: Daily P&L by symbol (attribution)
panels.description: IB's daily P&L per symbol, for open positions only (the P&L today tile is the whole account: it adds positions closed today and commissions). From SPX: beta delta $ x SPX move. Unexplained: P&L - From SPX. Delta: delta $ x the symbol's own move. Gamma: 1/2 gamma (dS)^2. Theta: one day of decay. Vega: vega x IV change since the day's first observation. Residual: the rest (today's trades, vanna/volga, dividends). P&L = Delta + Gamma + Theta + Vega + Residual.

panels.title: Symbols
panels.description: Net greeks of all stock and option positions per symbol. Hedge gamma P&L and net carry: delta hedging each symbol on a typical day of its own (last month's realized daily move).

properties.value: Gamma: the change in share delta per $1 move of the stock.
What delta hedging this symbol earns (long gamma, +) or costs (short gamma, -) on a typical day: 1/2 x gamma x (daily move x price)^2.
Theta + hedge gamma P&L: what holding the position delta-hedged makes on a typical day.
Today's P&L of all positions in this symbol, from IB (as in the Daily P&L by symbol table).

panels.title: Positions summary and SPX Δ=0 targets
panels.description: Per symbol: what you hold, and the target that makes SPX delta 0. 'Net target contracts' is the trade toward it: placed by the strategy only with place_target_orders = true (then it's in the Trade plan), otherwise for reference.

panels.title: Structures (option legs held as one position)
panels.description: Each symbol's option legs grouped into the positions they form, with combined figures, and the Portfolio Manager's priority and outcome (vault rules; it decides, the bot's roll/close rules no longer trade). Click a strategy for its review detail.

properties.value: Paid (+) or received (-) for the whole position.
At expiry, from the combined payoff. n/a: legs at several expiries.
Underlying prices at expiry where the whole position makes nothing.
Combined delta in shares of the underlying (sum of qty x 100 x leg delta).
P&L as a share of the premium, credit or debit.
The Portfolio Manager's highest open review signal (vault rules). Click the strategy for its detail.

targets.expr: sum by (name, kind, max_profit, max_loss, breakevens) (thetagang_structure_info)

panels.title: Positions
panels.description: Every position, grouped by symbol like the old bot (stock first, then options by expiry). Und. price: the underlying's price (the stock itself for stock rows). Delta, gamma, theta, vega: per share, as IB quotes them (stock delta = 1); x 100 x Qty for the position.

properties.value: Underlying price at expiry where this leg makes no P&L: strike + premium (calls), strike - premium (puts), long or short; stock: its cost. A spread leg's own breakeven ignores the other leg: see the Spreads table for the spread's.

panels.title: VIX / VIXMO
panels.description: The hedge buys by VIXMO allocation and sells above close_hedges_when_vix_exceeds

panels.title: Orders placed (per hour)
panels.description: Dry-run orders are counted too

panels.title: Open orders (count)
panels.description: Orders working at IB right now (any client: the strategy, pretrade or TWS). A symbol with an open order is skipped by the strategy until it fills or is cancelled.

panels.title: Open orders
panels.description: Every order working at IB now, from any client: the trading strategy (client ib.client_id), pretrade (+2), TWS (0). Limit: net price per unit (a combo: + debit, - credit). From the monitor's read-only IB connection, every minute.

targets.expr: sum by (id, order, type, status, client) (thetagang_open_order{job="thetagang",field="qty"})
